audit.why: whys[1] says he still out-ranges and out-pokes you at Level 2; whys[2] says to accept the deficit and farm; whys[4] says your R closes the gap on demand at 6. audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1].why and phases[2].why both describe Sion windows ('charged Q from brush is a half-HP knockup', 'your core pattern starts now') on the two rows Jayce owns hardest.

audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their own side, with Shock Blast's 16s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in the matchup. Every line says 'when Shock Blast is down' without ever saying how long that is, and the stance-swap ultimate — a 6s auto-attack reset whose first hit reduces your armour AND magic resist — is described only as 'swap to hammer stance to burst you'.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16/14/12/10/8/6, so at rank 1 there is a 16-second window where his poke is simply gone. Jayce's slots share cooldowns across stances: Thundering Blow and Acceleration Gate are the same 20/18/16/14/12/10 timer, so spending one spends both — that is why stepping up after the gate is laid is safe. And the swap resets his attack while shredding both resistances, which is the actual burst tell.
audit.corrected: 16s into whys[2], spikes[0] and phases[1]; the shared 20s E slot into whys[1] and wants.you[0]; the swap's shred and reset into wants.foe[2].

notes: The packet's suspectName 'His Shock Blast' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Shock Blast is the real Cannon-stance Q name; the flag fired on the leading word. Left in place and unverified, matching the mirror: whys[4] and mid both tell the player Unstoppable Onslaught 'cannot be interrupted by his E knockback', and whys[1] previously claimed the reverse case (that Thundering Blow interrupts a charging Q). Neither is answerable from Riot's text — Sion's R carries no unstoppable flag and his Q carries no channel flag. I rewrote whys[1] around the shared 20s E slot, which is verifiable, and left whys[4] and mid untouched rather than assert or deny the interaction. Note this is the same open question as sion vs heimerdinger, where an entire chart row rests on it. Full-layer mojibake em dashes copied exactly in 'before', plain hyphens in 'after'.
